title: WPMS/919/2007 of INTEZAR HUSSAIN AND ANR. Vs STATE AND ORS.

paras.text:
1
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Review Application No. 473 of 2013
Delay Condonation Application No. 8335 of 2013
In
 Writ Petition No. 919 of 2007 (M/S)
1. Intezar Hussain
S/o Late Irshad Hussain
2. Nazakat Hussain
 S/o Late Irshad Hussain
Both R/o Khushboo Farm
Opposite Hill View Service Station
Bareilly Road, Haldwani, District Nainital
 .........Writ Petitioners/Review Applicants
Versus
1. State of Uttarakhand
Through Secretary, Revenue Department,
District Nainital
2. Collector, District Nainital
3. Senior Superintendent of Police, Nainital
4. Municipal Board, Haldwani
District Nainital
Through its Executive Officer
5. Prescribed Authority
(U.P. Public Premises Act/City Magistrate)
Haldwani, District Nainital
...........Respondents
Shri Siddhartha Sah, Advocate holding brief of Shri Ahrar Baig,
Advocate, present for the writ petitioners/ review applicants.
Shri A.S.Rawat, Additional Advocate General, with Shri I.P.Kohli,
Advocate, present for the respondents No. 1, 2, 3 and 5.
Shri Ashish Joshi, Advocate, present for the respondent No. 4

2
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Delay Condonation Application No. 8335
of 2013 is allowed. Delay in filing the review
application is condoned.
(2) Heard on review application.
(3) By means of this review application, the
writ petitioners have sought review of the
judgment and order dated 13.05.2013 passed by
this court in Writ Petition No. 919 of 2007
(M/S).
(4) The writ petitioners filed the writ petition
challenging order dated 03.08.2007, passed by
Prescribed Authority/City Magistrate,
Haldwani, in a proceedings initiated against
them under Uttar Pradesh Public Premises
(Eviction of Unauthorized Occupants) Act,
1972. The question involved in said case was
whether the petitioners were tenure holders,
governed under any tenancy law, or they were

3
in occupation over Nazul land, and governed
by Uttar Pradesh Public Premises (Eviction of
Unauthorized Occupants) Act, 1972.
(5) After hearing the parties at length, said
writ petition was disposed of vide judgment
and order dated 13.05.2013, by this court,
holding that the writ petitioners are not a tenure
holders under any tenancy law and they were in
occupation of Nazul land to which the Uttar
Pradesh Public Premises (Eviction of
Unauthorized Occupants) Act, 1972, was
applicable.
(6) In the present review application reference
was made to para-1 and para 16A of Nazul
Manual, Schedule-I of Tenancy Act, 1939.
Section 17 of U.P. Urban or Zamindari
Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1956. Section
2 (aa) of Uttar Pradesh Public Premises
(Eviction of Unauthorized Occupants) Act,
1972, Annexure-2 and Annexure-6 filed with
the review application.

4
(7) As far as, Annexure-2 to the review
application is concerned, said document
appears to be executed between third parties,
and this court is of the view that the same is of
little help to the third parties. As far as the
provisions contained in Tenancy Act are
concerned, this court in its para 21 of the order
sought to be reviewed, has already given its
opinion before coming to the conclusion as to
why the petitioners cannot be said to tenure
holders. I have gone through section 2 (aa) of
Uttar Pradesh Public Premises (Eviction of
Unauthorized Occupants) Act, 1972, and this
also does not help the petitioners/review
applicants as it simply defines the law relating
to tenure holders. On the provision relating to
Nazul Manual also the issue involved are
already answered after consideration of
arguments of the parties in the order sought to
be reviewed. Para 16A of the Nazul Manual
shows it is gist of Government Order of 1953,
and cannot be said to be applicable lease given
prior to 1953.

5
(8) Having heard learned counsel for the
parties, and after going through the record of
the case, this court does not find any sufficient
ground to review or recall the order passed by
this court on 13.05.2013.
(9) Therefore, without prejudice to the rights
of the parties in the lis before the prescribed
authority in proceedings under Uttar Pradesh
Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorized
Occupants) Act, 1972, the review application
is dismissed. (CLMA No. 8335 of 2013 also
stands dismissed).
(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
Dt.20.08.2013
NP
